changelog:
Vanguard v1.0.42
- Sessions: role and control are now separate. A controller (host or admin) must SELECT the players they want to control - nobody is controlled automatically. Click a player to select/deselect them; click their role tag (M/A/I) to change role.
- Host can control anyone they select; an admin can control anyone they select including the host; a member is only controlled if selected AND opted in; an idiot is controlled when selected and is always locked out of their own toggles.
